scope: Metadata-only source-identity audit after R73 validation manifest creation and before any final reserve scoring. Every saved validation_tuples.json is conservatively treated as exposed, including started runs and copied smoke artifacts.
source_namespace: Original official TRAINING files only: (dataset name, zero-based original row). Dataset names distinguish identical numeric row IDs. Official TEST files are a separate namespace and were not read.

planned_fresh_reserve.manifest_hash_definition: SHA256 of sorted-key compact UTF-8 JSON with row and plane order preserved

training_overlap_scope: The complete recorded TRAIN pools were checked, a conservative superset of the images actually drawn by stochastic training; every saved train/val split is identical to the base split.

generated_metadata_not_evaluated.reason: source/src/train.py:183 uses bank.validation_manifest(cfg.val_per_group) for every evaluate call; line184 writes a separate bank.save_manifest() with its default512. EXPERIMENT_LOG.md:36 already documents this discrepancy. Extra tuples were generated as metadata, not evaluated.

method: Read saved JSON only. Rebuild reserve independently using sorted unused validation IDs, NumPy default_rng(30042+group), 128 quartets/group, homogeneous domains for the first three groups and independent uniform domains for mixed, without replacement within each dataset in a quartet. Reproduced the exact predeclared canonical SHA. Compare namespaced IDs against every saved validation tuple manifest, complete TRAIN pools, and auxiliary training/selection manifests.
limitations: This is a manifest/source-membership audit, not a reconstruction-quality result or proof from execution tracing. It covers saved artifacts at the recorded time. R73 may still be training; its split and validation manifest are already covered. The final reserve will be used for model selection and must not be reported as the independent final test.
